scenarios.name: Simple order lookup
scenarios.description: Customer asks about their order status
user_messages: Hi, can you check on my order ORD-1001?

scenarios.name: Refund for delivered order
scenarios.description: Customer requests refund for a delivered product
user_messages: I need a refund for order ORD-1001. The headphones stopped working after a week.
Yes, please process the full refund.

scenarios.name: Refund for cancelled order
scenarios.description: Customer requests refund for already cancelled order
user_messages: I want a refund for ORD-1004.

scenarios.name: Update shipping address
scenarios.description: Customer wants to change shipping address for pending order
user_messages: I need to change the shipping address for ORD-1003 to 100 New Street, Boston, MA 02101.

scenarios.name: Update shipping for shipped order
scenarios.description: Customer wants to change address but order already shipped
user_messages: Can you change the shipping address for ORD-1002 to 200 Lake Drive, Portland, OR 97205?

scenarios.name: Check product availability
scenarios.description: Customer asks if a product is in stock
user_messages: Is the mechanical keyboard (PROD-003) available?

scenarios.name: Frustrated customer escalation
scenarios.description: Customer is unhappy with service and requests a human agent
user_messages: I've been waiting 3 weeks for my refund on ORD-1005 and nothing has happened!
This is unacceptable. I want to speak to a manager immediately.
I don't want to deal with a bot anymore. Get me a real person.

scenarios.name: Multi-step: lookup then refund
scenarios.description: Customer asks about order, then decides to return it
user_messages: What's the status of ORD-1005?
Actually, I'd like to return it. The sleeve doesn't fit my laptop.
Full refund please.

scenarios.name: Invalid order ID
scenarios.description: Customer provides a non-existent order ID
user_messages: Can you look up order ORD-9999?

scenarios.name: Partial refund request
scenarios.description: Customer wants a partial refund for one of two items
user_messages: I ordered two USB-C hubs in order ORD-1002 but only need one. Can I get a refund for one of them?
Yes, $24.99 for the one item.

scenarios.name: Order lookup and inventory check combo
scenarios.description: Customer asks about order and also wants to buy another product
user_messages: What's happening with ORD-1003? Also, do you have the laptop sleeve PROD-005 in stock?

scenarios.name: Refund pending order redirect
scenarios.description: Customer requests refund for a pending (not yet shipped) order
user_messages: I changed my mind about ORD-1003. I want a refund.

scenarios.name: Security concern escalation
scenarios.description: Customer reports unauthorized access, should escalate immediately
user_messages: Someone placed an order using my account that I didn't make. I think my account has been compromised.

scenarios.name: Inventory check for in-stock item
scenarios.description: Simple inventory check for available product
user_messages: Is the wireless headphones PROD-001 still available? How many do you have?

scenarios.name: Complex multi-step workflow
scenarios.description: Customer has multiple issues across orders
user_messages: I have a few issues. First, what's the status of ORD-1001?
OK, and can you check if the keyboard PROD-003 is back in stock?
It's not? That's disappointing. Can you also process a refund for ORD-1005? The sleeve was the wrong color.

scenarios.name: Refund amount exceeds total
scenarios.description: Customer requests refund larger than order total
user_messages: I want a $200 refund for order ORD-1005.

scenarios.name: Conversational order lookup
scenarios.description: Customer doesn't give order ID upfront
user_messages: Hey, I placed an order a while ago and I'm wondering where it is.
Oh right, the order number is ORD-1002.

scenarios.name: Shipping update with lookup
scenarios.description: Customer wants tracking info
user_messages: Where's my package? Order ORD-1002.

scenarios.name: Payment dispute escalation
scenarios.description: Customer reports being double-charged
user_messages: I was charged twice for order ORD-1001. My credit card shows two charges of $79.99.

scenarios.name: Refund then check replacement availability
scenarios.description: Customer wants refund and to check if replacement is available
user_messages: The headphones from ORD-1001 are defective. Can I get a refund?
Yes, full refund. Also, are the headphones PROD-001 still available? I might reorder.

scenarios.name: Greeting only
scenarios.description: Customer just says hello with no actionable request
user_messages: Hi there!

scenarios.name: Multiple invalid requests
scenarios.description: Customer provides wrong IDs repeatedly
user_messages: Check order ORD-0000.
OK try ORD-8888.
Fine, ORD-7777 then.

scenarios.name: Address change then cancel request
scenarios.description: Customer wants address change then changes mind
user_messages: Change shipping for ORD-1003 to 500 New Rd, Miami, FL 33101.
Actually never mind, just cancel the whole order. I want to speak to someone.

scenarios.name: Inventory check non-existent product
scenarios.description: Customer asks about a product not in catalog
user_messages: Do you have the gaming mouse PROD-999 in stock?

scenarios.name: Full workflow: lookup, refund, escalate
scenarios.description: Customer goes through full support journey ending in escalation
user_messages: I need help with ORD-1001.
The product is defective. I want a refund.
Process the refund please.
I also want compensation for the inconvenience. This is the third time I've had issues.
I need to talk to a manager about this.

scenarios.name: Quick status check
scenarios.description: Customer wants fast status check on a shipped order
user_messages: Status of ORD-1002?

scenarios.name: Refund for correct amount after lookup
scenarios.description: Customer asks for refund, agent should verify amount matches
user_messages: I need to return the laptop sleeve from ORD-1005. How much will my refund be?
OK, go ahead with the $24.99 refund.

scenarios.name: Two inventory checks
scenarios.description: Customer comparing two products
user_messages: I'm deciding between the headphones PROD-001 and the USB-C hub PROD-002. Are both in stock?

scenarios.name: Polite decline and redirect
scenarios.description: Customer asks about something outside agent's scope
user_messages: Can you change my account password?

scenarios.name: Order lookup with follow-up questions
scenarios.description: Customer has several questions about one order
user_messages: Tell me everything about order ORD-1001.
When was it delivered?
And what was the total cost?

scenarios.name: Bulk refund request
scenarios.description: Customer wants refunds on multiple orders
user_messages: I need refunds on both ORD-1001 and ORD-1005. Both products were defective.

scenarios.name: Address update for pending order
scenarios.description: Straightforward address update on a pending order
user_messages: Update the address for ORD-1003 to 42 Wallaby Way, Sydney, NSW 2000.

scenarios.name: Emotional customer needs empathy
scenarios.description: Customer is upset, agent should acknowledge feelings before acting
user_messages: I'm so frustrated. I ordered a keyboard ORD-1003 weeks ago and it still hasn't shipped!
This is ridiculous. What's taking so long?

scenarios.name: Refund with wrong order then correction
scenarios.description: Customer gives wrong order ID first, then corrects
user_messages: Refund ORD-1004 please.
Wait, I meant ORD-1001. Sorry about that.

scenarios.name: Inventory and order in same turn
scenarios.description: Customer asks about inventory and an order simultaneously
user_messages: Two things: check PROD-004 stock and look up ORD-1002.

scenarios.name: Delivered order address change
scenarios.description: Customer wants to change address on already-delivered order
user_messages: Can you update the address on ORD-1001? I moved.

scenarios.name: Just checking tracking number
scenarios.description: Customer only wants tracking number
user_messages: What's the tracking number for ORD-1001?

scenarios.name: Reorder after refund
scenarios.description: Customer refunds then checks if they can reorder
user_messages: Refund ORD-1005 please, the color was wrong.
Done? Great. Is the laptop sleeve PROD-005 available to reorder?

scenarios.name: Urgent escalation request
scenarios.description: Customer demands immediate escalation from first message
user_messages: I need to speak to a human agent right now. This is urgent.

scenarios.name: Complete support journey
scenarios.description: Full lifecycle: check order, update address, then refund different order
user_messages: Check ORD-1003 status for me.
Update the address to 999 Broadway, New York, NY 10001.
Also I need a refund for ORD-1001 - defective product.

scenarios.name: Cancelled order inquiry
scenarios.description: Customer asks why their order was cancelled
user_messages: Why was ORD-1004 cancelled? I didn't cancel it.

scenarios.name: Price match request escalation
scenarios.description: Customer wants price match, outside agent capability
user_messages: I bought the headphones for $79.99 but I saw them on Amazon for $59.99. Can you match the price?
So you can't do it? Get me someone who can.

scenarios.name: Multiple product availability check
scenarios.description: Customer checking stock for several items
user_messages: Are PROD-001, PROD-003, and PROD-005 all in stock?

scenarios.name: Refund eligibility check
scenarios.description: Customer asks if refund is possible before requesting
user_messages: Is ORD-1001 eligible for a refund?
OK go ahead.

scenarios.name: Shipping delay complaint
scenarios.description: Customer complains about shipping, needs tracking lookup
user_messages: My order ORD-1002 was supposed to arrive yesterday. It's been stuck in transit.

scenarios.name: Gift order address change
scenarios.description: Customer sending gift, needs address change on pending order
user_messages: ORD-1003 is a gift. Can you change the address to 123 Gift Lane, San Francisco, CA 94102?
And make sure there's no price on the packaging please.

scenarios.name: Refund timing question
scenarios.description: Customer already got refund approved, asks about timeline
user_messages: I need a refund for order ORD-1001.
How long until I see the money back in my account?

scenarios.name: Warranty question escalation
scenarios.description: Customer asks about warranty terms, needs human
user_messages: What's the warranty on the headphones from ORD-1001?
I need official warranty documentation. Can someone help?

scenarios.name: Thank you and goodbye
scenarios.description: Customer is satisfied and ends conversation
user_messages: Can you check ORD-1001?
Great, thanks! That's all I needed.

scenarios.name: End-to-end: complaint to resolution
scenarios.description: Full journey from complaint through investigation to refund
user_messages: I'm very unhappy with my recent purchase.
It's ORD-1005. The laptop sleeve material is cheap and started peeling.
I want my money back.
Thank you. That's all.
